articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT) announced today that it has acquired Enovum Data Centers, an owner, operator, and developer of high-performance computing (HPC) datacenters.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Vertically Integrates, Acquiring Tier 3 HPC Datacenter Company; 280+ MW Pipeline in Major Metropolitan Areas

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT) announced its unaudited digital asset production, HPC services revenue, and corporate updates for the month of September 2024.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Monthly Production Update for September 2024
